components.what: Calculate the future value of the initial deposit and the monthly annuity after 84 months.

log.author: C

- Monthly deposit ($PMT$): \$350

- Monthly interest rate ($i$): $\frac{0.036}{12} = 0.003$

log.answer:
To calculate the balance immediately after the 84th deposit, we compute the future value of the initial deposit and the future value of the monthly ordinary annuity:

- Principal ($P$): $7,500
- Monthly deposit ($PMT$): $350
- Monthly interest rate ($i$): $\frac{0.036}{12} = 0.003$
- Number of periods ($n$): 84

1. Future Value of Initial Principal ($FV_P$):
$$FV_P = P(1 + i)^n = 7500 \times (1.003)^{84} \approx 7500 \times 1.28611187 \approx 9645.839$$

2. Future Value of Annuity ($FV_{PMT}$):
$$FV_{PMT} = PMT \times \frac{(1 + i)^n - 1}{i} = 350 \times \frac{(1.003)^{84} - 1}{0.003} \approx 350 \times 95.370622 \approx 33379.718$$

3. Total Balance:
$$\text{Total} = FV_P + FV_{PMT} \approx 9645.839 + 33379.718 = 43025.557$$

Rounding to the nearest cent gives 43025.56.

FINAL: 43025.56
